entries.title: See which messages came from infinitary-axi
entries.body: A message, a reply under a card or a choice sent from infinitary-axi now says so. Your first mate reads it as yours, sent from your terminal, a script or one of your own agents, and the conversation and card threads show From infinitary-axi beside your line.

picture.alt: Your last message above the input with From infinitary-axi beside it, and your first mate's reply under it
